product.title: Dublin to Wicklow, Glendalough Small Group Tour with Guided Walk

description.text: Leave Dublin for an eight-hour small-group day that pairs a guided walk in Wicklow National Park with time in Glendalough. After the hike, the group pauses for lunch in a Victorian village, then explores the medieval abbey setting before the return coach. Live commentary covers countryside lanes that are easy to miss from a rental car, and the driver-guide keeps hike and monastic timing on one vehicle. Meet at the Molly Malone statue on Suffolk Street. The outing is built for visitors who want a Wicklow walk plus Glendalough from a Dublin base. Stops include Wicklow National Park, Glendalough.

highlights: Visiting Dublin is not experiencing the real Ireland
